# gopherkind-protocol-py

> Validating and rendering Gopherkind (Nostr kind 31436) documents needs a
> parser for the kindmap grammar, NIP-01 replacement ordering and NIP-40
> expiry, but the reference implementation is TypeScript. gopherkind-protocol
> is an independent Python implementation of the same grammar, built from
> `SPEC.md` and the published language-neutral fixture rather than by
> translating the TypeScript source.

For Python projects consuming or serving Gopherkind documents over Nostr: it
validates document metadata and exact paths, parses kindmap lines, picks the
NIP-01 replacement winner among same-address events, applies NIP-40 expiry,
and renders RFC 1436 type `0` wire bodies. It starts after ordinary NIP-01
event id and signature validation, which stays the caller's responsibility.
No runtime dependency.

## Getting Started

```sh
git clone https://github.com/forgesworn/gopherkind-protocol-py
cd gopherkind-protocol-py
pip install -e .
```

```python
from gopherkind_protocol import parse_document, url_path

document = parse_document(event)  # event is a NIP-01 kind 31436 event dict
if document is not None:
    print(document.path, document.type, document.title)
    print(url_path(document.path))
```

## Key Concepts

- `Document`: the validated `path`, `type` (`0` or `1`) and `title` from a
  kind 31436 event's `d`, `type` and `title` tags.
- `KindmapLine`: one parsed line of a Gopher kindmap, with `type`, `display`
  and an optional `link`; control characters other than SGR colour codes are
  replaced with spaces.
- Replacement winner: among events sharing an address, NIP-01 ordering picks
  the highest `created_at`, then the lowest event id.
- Expiry: a `current_document` result is suppressed once its NIP-40
  `expiration` tag has passed.

## API Surface

- `parse_document(event)`: validate a kind 31436 event, return a `Document`
  or `None`.
- `valid_path(value)`: check a string is a well-formed exact path.
- `url_path(value)`: percent-encode each path segment without normalising it.
- `parse_kindmap(content)`: parse kindmap text into a list of `KindmapLine`.
- `replacement_winner(events)`: pick the NIP-01 replacement winner from an
  iterable of events.
- `current_document(events, now)`: winner after validation and NIP-40 expiry
  against `now`.
- `render_type0(content)`: render text content as an RFC 1436 type `0` wire
  body, with dot-stuffing and the terminating `.\r\n`.
- `DOC_KIND`: the Nostr kind constant, `31436`.
